summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Eenera V1 Governance Engine. Major session persistence issue has been resolved within active sessions. All core functionality working including registration, dashboard features, and navigation to main pages. Minor session persistence issue remains between browser instances.

ui_bugs.issue: JWT token persistence fails when starting new browser instances, but works correctly within continuous sessions

Frontend: Registration toggle functionality works

Frontend: Successful redirect to dashboard after registration
Frontend: Dashboard loads with complete sidebar navigation
Frontend: User profile display in header with correct user info
Frontend: Organization selector dropdown functionality
Frontend: New Organization creation via dialog
